The Mechanic Jacket is nothing new for us here. We started making this cut years ago to provide a layer that was ready to work under the hood deep into any season. We started with a 10oz duck cotton canvas back in '18, worked on a heavier 11.75 oz cotton duck canvas with our friends at New Legend 4x4 in 2021, and came up with this blanket lined waxed canvas version for this Fall.
Built with a durable waxed cotton canvas, the Mechanic Jacket provides excellent wind and debris resistance, making this outerwear piece perfect for life in and out of the garage . Designed with a front button entry and paired with a custom blanket liner, it'll keep the vitals warm when necessary. We gave the jacket double needle felled seams throughout so you know it’s in it for the long haul, especially once that patina starts developing on the waxed cotton canvas. Ready for a lifetime of wear, and more.
